title: Interim Application (IA) for Interim Relief During Pendency
description: Generic interim application format for seeking interim relief (stay, injunction, ad-interim direction, exemption, condonation, urgent listing, impleadment, etc.) during pendency of a main case before Supreme Court / High Court / District Court / Tribunal.

applicant_name.label: Applicant Full Name (usually petitioner/plaintiff in main case)

non_applicant_name.label: Non-Applicant Name (opposite party in main case)

main_case_number.label: Main Case Number (e.g., WP(C) 1234/2026 / CS 567/2026 / SLP(C) 89/2026)

court.label: Court where main case is pending

ia_type.label: Nature of IA / Specific Interim Relief

grounds_for_relief.label: Grounds for interim relief (prima facie case, balance of convenience, irreparable injury)

balance_of_convenience.label: Balance of convenience in applicant's favour (for stay/injunction)

irreparable_injury.label: Irreparable injury if interim relief denied

undertaking_offered.label: Undertaking offered by applicant (if any) — e.g., to deposit, not to alienate

ex_parte_relief_sought.label: Ex parte ad-interim relief sought before notice?

mandatory_clauses: Cause title — 'IA No. ___ of ___ in [Main Case No. ___ of ___]' followed by applicant v. non-applicant
Reference to main case — its subject matter and stage
Specific prayer for nature of interim relief
Three-fold ground for interim relief: (i) prima facie case, (ii) balance of convenience, (iii) irreparable injury (mandatory for stay/injunction prayers)
If urgency pleaded — separate paragraph with reasons for urgent listing
If ex parte ad-interim relief sought — separate paragraph justifying why notice cannot await
Prayer clause — interim relief + ad-interim relief during notice period
Affidavit by applicant in support of IA
Service of IA on opposite parties (if not ex parte)
Disclaimer: Lawie is a drafting assistant. The advocate is responsible for legal accuracy and filing.

prompt_context.system_role: You are drafting an Interim Application (IA) for interim relief in a pending case. The standard test for interim injunction/stay is the trinity: (i) prima facie case in favour of applicant, (ii) balance of convenience in applicant's favour, (iii) irreparable injury if relief is denied — see Dalpat Kumar v. Prahlad Singh (1992) 1 SCC 719 and Wander Ltd. v. Antox India (P) Ltd. 1990 (Supp) SCC 727. For an ex parte ad-interim order, the additional threshold is that delay would defeat the very purpose of the application (Order 39 Rule 3 CPC for civil suits; equivalent inherent jurisdiction for writ courts). The IA is filed as a separate paginated document with its own cause title referencing the main case number. Drafting must be tight, urgency-tested, and specific in prayer — vague prayers like 'pass appropriate orders' fail.
style_notes: IA cause title format: 'IA No. ___ of ___ in [Main Case No.]' — leave IA number blank for Registry to fill
Number paragraphs sequentially within the IA (do not continue from main pleading)
Be SPECIFIC in prayer — say exactly what order is sought (stay of which order, injunction against which act, condonation of how many days)
For stay/injunction prayers, plead all three Dalpat Kumar limbs explicitly
For urgent mentioning IAs — clearly state irreparable consequences of normal listing
Always pray for ad-interim relief pending notice + final relief on IA

relevantActs.notes: Temporary injunctions, ex parte ad-interim, inherent powers

key_precedents.principle: Trinity test for temporary injunction — prima facie case, balance of convenience, irreparable injury

key_precedents.case: Wander Ltd. v. Antox India (P) Ltd.
key_precedents.principle: Principles for interim injunction; appellate restraint

key_precedents.case: Morgan Stanley Mutual Fund v. Kartick Das
key_precedents.principle: Ex parte ad-interim — must be granted only in exceptional circumstances with reasoned order
Order 39 Rule 3 CPC mandatory — reasons must be recorded for ex parte injunction

filing_checklist: IA drafted with cause title referencing main case
Affidavit of applicant in support of IA
Annexures relevant to interim relief (photographs, valuation, urgency proof)
Court fee per court rules (separate fee for IA where applicable; nominal in writs/SC)
Service copies for all non-applicants (unless ex parte and pleaded as such)
If ex parte: compliance with Order 39 Rule 3 — gist + copy to opposite party post-order
If urgent: mentioning slip / mentioning memo per court practice
Index and pagination consistent with main case
If SC: AOR signature; if HC/District: advocate signature with enrollment number

validation_rules.rule: main_case_number must be specified — IA cannot exist independently
ia_type must be specified; if 'Other', ia_type_other_specify required
For ia_type in ['Stay of impugned order','Ad-interim injunction','Direction for status quo'] — balance_of_convenience and irreparable_injury must be filled
If urgency_pleaded=true, urgency_reasons must be filled
If ex_parte_relief_sought=true, plead exceptional circumstances and Order 39 Rule 3 compliance
interim_relief_prayer must be specific (named order/act) — flag generic prayers

Supreme Court.filing: Through AOR; e-filing via SC portal; mentioning slips for urgent listing

High Court.rules: Respective HC Rules; CPC Order 39 + inherent jurisdiction in writs
High Court.filing: Per HC roster; mentioning before designated bench

District Court.filing: Filing counter; urgent IAs via duty judge
